host.description: AXIS camera host or IP. Injected per target at runtime from credential rules / SRQL-scoped targets; not configured per assignment.

username.description: Camera API username. Stored on a username/password credential secret, not on this assignment.

password_secret_ref.description: Secret reference for the camera API password. Created by a credential rule, not entered here.

rtsp_port.description: RTSP port (appended to the stream URL only when non-standard)

collect_events.description: Collect camera events from VAPIX websocket stream

event_topic_filters.description: Comma or newline separated VAPIX topic filters for websocket events

event_sources.description: VAPIX websocket sources query string value
